purpose: Teach: 珪/聾/鞍/烏/瑤/螢/禄/鄭

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療機器の珪素、つまり珪チップの劣化を医療チームで監視します
lines.en: Ren, our medical team will monitor the degradation of silicon components in your medical devices.
lines.style: Clear, professional opener. Steady pace, even emphasis. Calm reassurance without condescension. Clinical but warm — the tone of someone explaining something important to someone she trusts.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、聾、つまり聴覚障害患者様の手話通訳を医療チームで配置します
lines.en: Ren, we'll have a sign language interpreter positioned with our medical team to support you.
lines.style: Slight pause before the key information. Deliberate, respectful pacing. The care in her voice comes through in the precision — showing she's thought this through.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、馬術選手の鞍、つまり鞍負荷による腰痛を医療チームで治療します
lines.en: Ren, our medical team will treat the lower back pain caused by saddle pressure in your equestrian work.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact medical tone. Direct statement of the problem and solution. No filler. Professional warmth — acknowledging her specific situation without fanfare.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、烏、つまりカラスの咬傷症例を医療チームで治療します
lines.en: Ren, we have experience treating bite injuries from animal encounters, and our team will manage yours.
lines.style: Steady, reassuring delivery. Slight emphasis on 'experience' — building confidence. Calm, unhurried pacing. The tone that says: this is handled.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、旧字「瑤」、つまり瑤を含む医薬古書を医療チームで保管します
lines.en: Ren, our medical team will preserve historical medical texts that reference this kanji in our archives.
lines.style: Formal, measured tone. Each phrase given equal weight. Speaking to the significance of preserving knowledge. Clinical precision with quiet respect.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、旧字「螢」、つまり蛍光標識を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren, we're conducting research into fluorescent markers in medical contexts — our team will keep you informed.
lines.style: Slight lift on 'research' — this is ongoing work. Interested tone, not dry. Steady pace. The voice of someone who finds this meaningful and wants to share that.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、江戸の禄、つまり俸禄医制度の医療史を医療チームで学びます
lines.en: Ren, our medical team is studying the historical relationship between stipend systems and medical practice in the Edo period.
lines.style: Contemplative opener. Slower pace — this is context, not urgency. Thoughtful tone. The voice of someone connecting past to present. Composed and intellectually present.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、中国系患者鄭様のご症状を医療チームで継続観察します
lines.en: Ren, we'll continue close observation of Mr. Zhen's symptoms with our medical team.
lines.style: Gentle shift to slightly warmer register. Close focus — narrowing from general to this specific patient. Steady, attentive tone. The care is in the attention to the individual case.
